text:
maya: Quick design feedback from the rollout panel review — Console labels the quick toggle 'Canary' while the docs H1 uses 'Rollout strategy'. Users clicking Help see 'Canary' then land on 'Rollout' docs; it's jarring.

todd: Hmm. Which term is product-canonical? @eli any history?

eli: Docs team here: we documented the feature as 'Rollout' because the guide covers multiple strategies (canary, blue/green, staged). But the Console microcopy uses 'Canary' because the default is a canary toggle.

maya: UX nit: the in-product docs panel title is short; we shouldn't shove long parentheticals like 'Canary (Rollout strategy)'. That breaks on small widths.

docs-bot: search-metrics: users search "canary" 34% vs "rollout" 66% in the engineering docs over 90 days.

kevin-design: Design proposal: keep Console control labeled 'Canary' (familiar shorthand) but make the Help inlay show a compact link: 'Rollout docs' with a tiny subtitle/tooltip 'Canary = one rollout type'. Avoid long inline aliases.

a11y: Accessibility: screen readers announce the toggle label verbatim. If the Console says 'Canary' and the doc H1 says 'Rollout strategy' it will sound inconsistent. We need ARIA parity and clear announcements on the micro-link.

eli: Docs plan: add a small anchor at the top of the rollout doc: H1 = 'Rollout strategy', then first line: 'In the Console the toggle is labeled "Canary" — see note.' Also add a /docs/canary redirect for old links.

maya: Alternative UX: change Console label to 'Rollout (canary)' but that will wrap poorly. I prefer Kevin's micro-link: keep short target label, add 'Learn more: Rollout strategy' link in the inlay.

todd: Engineering: can we add a search synonym so queries for 'canary' surface the rollout doc? Also add an analytics ping when users click the micro-link so we can measure confusion.

eli: Yes, we'll add 'canary -> rollout' synonyms and a small redirect for /docs/canary to /docs/rollout. I'll draft the docs blurb and the redirect.

a11y: For SR, set aria-label on the micro-link like: 'Rollout docs, explains that Console label "Canary" refers to rollout strategy' so screen readers get immediate context. Also ensure keyboard focus lands on the micro-link before opening external docs.

kevin-design: I'll mock two variants in Figma: A) Console keeps 'Canary' + tiny 'Rollout docs' link, B) Console changes to 'Rollout' full word. I'll test wrapping on 320px and SR reads. Posting by EOD.

maya: Owners & timeline: docs=eli to add alias + redirect by Wed, design=kevin to post Figma frames by EOD today, eng=todd to add search synonym + analytics next sprint, a11y to validate once mock is staged.

todd: I'll feature-flag the small redirect and search update so we can validate metrics before wide rollout.

maya: TL;DR: prefer keeping 'Canary' label in Console for brevity; add clear micro-link to 'Rollout strategy' docs, fix aria labels, add search synonym and redirect. Owners posted. :+1:

eli: Thanks — I'll open the docs PR and include the alias sentence at top."
